build_LoadMultiViewImageFromFiles: build a pipeline to load multi-view images from a list of filenames into stacked numpy arrays
build_LoadPointsFromMultiSweeps: build a pipeline to load and concatenate point clouds from multiple LiDAR sweeps for nuScenes datasets
build_PointSegClassMapping: build a pipeline to remap point cloud semantic class IDs to a contiguous valid category range
build_NormalizePointsColor: build a pipeline to normalize RGB color channels of point clouds by subtracting a mean color value
build_LoadPointsFromFile: build a pipeline to load point cloud data from binary or numpy files with configurable coordinate types
